newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Markets quiet.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Markets quiet.

text.p: U.S. millfeed markets were quiet Thursday and prices were mostly unchanged, dealers said.

Several dealers said feedmixers appeared to be well supplied with product and were not anxious to add to inventories. Also, lower CBOT corn futures Thursday and the availabilty of recently harvested wheat has discouraged feedmixers from aggressively buying millfeeds.
Adequate pastures from Kansas to Texas also lessened the need for supplemental feed.
In North Carolina, high temperatures continued, which had livestock eating less feed, a broker said.
